## About
We're on Freeport Road in Blawnox, just a few blocks past the Waterworks Mall, and we do auto body and collision work for neighbors in Fox Chapel, Oakmont, Aspinwall and beyond. Scratches, dents, frame realignments and paint matching are all done right here in the shop.
We're a Gold Class collision repair business, which means the technicians working on your car keep up with training on new vehicle technologies and repair techniques. People have been kind about us online too, with a 4.8 rating from 32 Google reviews.
One customer brought his new Trax to us after hitting a deer, then came back after sliding into someone during a January snow storm. Another told us we were his go-to after his car was hit in the area. That's the kind of trust we work to keep.

## Services
- Collision and Auto Body Repairs: Body work repairs after an accident, big or small.
- Major and Minor Collision Repairs: From a backed-into bumper to serious damage.
- Scratch and Dent Repairs: Door dings, scrapes and dents taken care of.
- Frame Realignments: Part of the full range of body work we do in the shop.
- Computerized paint matching: So the repaired panel matches the rest of your car.
- Insurance Claims Accepted: We'll work with your insurance on the repair.

## FAQ
Q: Do you accept insurance claims?
A: Yes. Insurance claims are accepted, and we'll work with your insurer on the repair.

Q: Do you work on foreign cars?
A: We work on all makes and models, foreign and domestic.

Q: Where are you and when are you open?
A: We're at 234 Freeport Road in Blawnox, just a few blocks past the Waterworks Mall. We're open Monday through Friday, 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM, and closed Saturday and Sunday.
